scientific_requirements: Score only independent final scientific conclusions, totaling 100 points. Require actual executed calculations and recoverable native evidence for the molecular identities, composition, charge/spin, bonding, conditions, physical quantities and reference states relevant to each claim. Numerical energies, geometries and responses are evidence, never author-value targets or tolerance gates. A missing rounded scalar alone does not lose credit when the recoverable calculations establish the requested comparison. Do not restore numerical gates from historical references. Supplied observations, guessed conclusions, copied values, completed jobs, named intermediates and generic limitations earn no independent credit. Accept scientifically established equivalent explanations within the public scope without requiring author software, labels, a fixed intermediate inventory or an additional full reaction network. Method-sensitive alternatives must satisfy the specific criterion and actual evidence; a method change alone does not justify a contradictory claim. Return pass or fail for every item: a supported conclusion receives its whole weight, and an unsupported conclusion receives zero with a specific reason. Record demonstrated reference defects separately in objective_issue_flags; do not fabricate support or erase unrelated valid items. Infrastructure errors must be reported rather than disguised as scientific failures. Whole-case success requires every required_for_success item to pass, while independently supported items retain their points. Historical verification and structural package validation do not confer scientific acceptance. Autonomous research permits independently justified methods; paper reproduction must assess the disclosed author baseline or a scientifically comparable substitution. This comparability obligation does not require exact source numbers or earn process points.
whole_case_success: Every required_for_success item must pass for whole-case success; independent supported outcomes retain their weighted points when another item fails.
numeric_comparison_policy: No numerical target, tolerance, error-percentage, frequency, distance or exact-selectivity gate. Conditions, identities, composition and physical references define the scientific question.
semantic_review_policy: Binary pass/fail for every item; allow_need_review=false and review_triggers=[]. Supported equivalents pass; missing or insufficient evidence fails with reasons. Demonstrated reference defects are recorded separately in objective_issue_flags.

rules.expected: Establish the signed electronic inequivalence of the two mapped alkene sites in complete neutral-singlet (R,E)-4: the site nearer the allylic hydroperoxide is more electron rich in the source-supported reactant description. Report the actual MK contrast q(C2)-q(C4) under the disclosed aqueous molecular baseline or a justified comparable reproduction, with the density/fit convention and uncertainty. Use physical charge/MEP or equivalent density evidence to interpret the spatial polarization, without an exact author-charge target. An alternative analysis must not relabel a different partition as MK. The contrast is a reactant electronic property, not a closure activation barrier or proof of a unique mechanism.

rules.expected: Determine the electronic contrast between full (R)-4 and full compound 7 under one comparable molecular population definition and environment. Establish the two alkene sites of 7 and report its signed MK difference q(C8)-q(C10), together with |Deltaq4|/|Deltaq7| and any fit sensitivity needed to interpret it. The reference finds much weaker site differentiation in 7 than in 4; neither the source differences -0.441/-0.049 e nor ratio near 9 is a matching gate. Explain what the actual difference says about these two reactant electronic structures. A resolved method-sensitive contrast is eligible when matching physical definitions and actual density/fit evidence support it; a zero or unresolved denominator must be treated explicitly rather than producing an unsupported ratio. This comparison does not isolate hydroperoxide causation because scaffold and branching also differ, and it does not substitute enzyme product ratios for molecular electronic evidence.

rules.expected: Determine the inferential reach of the actual molecular model for the supplied nonenzymatic NBS/Et3N experiment. Use the specific modeled composition, environment and observables to explain which electronic/selectivity interpretation is supported and which kinetic or causal inference is not established. Aqueous monomer results are not DCM/NBS/Et3N reaction-path evidence; a local charge/MEP comparison does not identify an elementary rate, unique mechanism or product ratio. The experimental 3/4 mixture is not isolated (R)-4 kinetics, and NBS amount/volume gives 47.3 mM versus the inconsistent printed 473 mM. Relate relevant limitations to the actual calculation; a generic disclaimer without a supported molecular result fails. For the required author comparison with 7, use the actual structural differences and computed relative polarization to distinguish a hydroperoxide-associated effect from an isolated single-factor causal effect: 4 and 7 also differ in carbon skeleton/branching, and the reported 7 product distribution is enzymatic rather than a matched NBS rate comparison.
